zh.title: 美國阿拉斯加Ryan Air接收一架Saab 340B貨機
zh.summary: 美國阿拉斯加州航空業者Ryan Air於2026年8月5日接收由租賃公司Jetstream Aviation Capital交付的一架Saab 340B(F)全貨機。該架國籍標誌暨登記號碼為N329AE的飛機將投入阿拉斯加西部的定期與包機貨運服務，支援當地80多個社區的物資輸送。
body: 飛機租賃公司Jetstream Aviation Capital於2026年8月5日向總部位於阿拉斯加的Ryan Air交付一架Saab 340B(F)貨機。該架飛機登記號碼為N329AE，自貝靈漢國際機場起飛，經過5小時飛行後降落於安克拉治泰德·史蒂文斯國際機場。
Ryan Air將把該貨機投入阿拉斯加西部的定期與包機貨運服務，支援80多個社區的物資輸送。這架機齡33年的Saab 340過去曾於Flagship Airlines、American Eagle與Wings West Airlines擔任客機。Ryan Air為Saltchuk Aviation旗下公司，營運機型包含Cessna 207與Pilatus PC-12。

en.title: Alaska Cargo Carrier Ryan Air Takes Delivery of Saab 340B(F)
en.summary: Alaska-based carrier Ryan Air received a single Saab 340B(F) cargo aircraft from aircraft lessor Jetstream Aviation Capital on August 5, 2026. Registered as N329AE, the aircraft completed a five-hour flight from Bellingham International Airport to Anchorage Ted Stevens International Airport. The freighter will be deployed on scheduled and chartered cargo operations throughout Western Alaska, supporting essential supply movement to more than 80 communities. Ryan Air is a subsidiary of Saltchuk Aviation, which also operates Northern Air Cargo and Aloha Air Cargo.
body: Lessor Jetstream Aviation Capital delivered a Saab 340B(F) cargo aircraft to Alaska-based Ryan Air on August 5, 2026. The aircraft, registered N329AE, arrived at Anchorage Ted Stevens International Airport after a five-hour flight from Bellingham International Airport.

The aircraft will be used for scheduled and chartered cargo operations throughout Western Alaska, serving more than 80 communities. Prior to conversion, the 33-year-old Saab 340 operated as a passenger aircraft for Flagship Airlines, American Eagle, and Wings West Airlines. Ryan Air is part of Saltchuk Aviation, which also owns Northern Air Cargo and Aloha Air Cargo, and operates a fleet including Cessna 207 and Pilatus PC-12 aircraft.

zh.title: 日本航空與馬來西亞航空推動福岡吉隆坡共享航班
zh.summary: 日本航空與馬來西亞航空深化合作，自2026年8月7日起為馬來西亞航空預計於9月2日開航的福岡至吉隆坡航線預售代碼共享機票。馬來西亞航空亦將在日航執飛的日本國內接駁航班掛牌。該營運計劃仍需取得政府許可。
body: 日本航空與馬來西亞航空展開新階段合作，著眼於推進日本區域旅遊發展。雙方針對馬來西亞航空預計於2026年9月2日開航的福岡至吉隆坡航線實施代碼共享，日本航空自8月7日起已開始銷售該航線機票，航班號碼分別為JL7098與JL7099。
除了這條國際航線外，馬來西亞航空也將在其班號掛載於日本航空營運、往返福岡機場的日本國內線航班，以利國際旅客接駁至日本各地區。此外，日本航空針對里程計畫會員推出雙倍里程活動，註冊時間為8月7日至10月31日，適用搭乘期間為9月2日至2027年3月31日。相關航線營運仍須視政府審查批准而定。

en.title: Japan Airlines and Malaysia Airlines Launch Fukuoka-Kuala Lumpur Codeshare
en.summary: Japan Airlines and Malaysia Airlines have expanded their partnership with a codeshare arrangement centered on Malaysia Airlines' new Fukuoka-Kuala Lumpur route, scheduled to launch on September 2, 2026. Sales for the codeshare flights opened on August 7, 2026, under JAL flight numbers JL7098 and JL7099. Furthermore, Malaysia Airlines will add its flight code to JAL-operated domestic flights connecting through Fukuoka Airport to give incoming international passengers smoother access to regional Japan. All schedules and operations remain subject to government approval.
body: Japan Airlines (JAL) has extended its partnership with Malaysia Airlines to support regional tourism in Japan. Centered on Malaysia Airlines' new Fukuoka-Kuala Lumpur service launching September 2, 2026, JAL began selling tickets for the codeshare route on August 7, 2026, under flight numbers JL7098 and JL7099.

As part of the collaboration, Malaysia Airlines will also place its flight code on JAL-operated domestic flights connecting to and from Fukuoka Airport. Additionally, JAL is launching a Double Miles Campaign for loyalty members traveling on the route between September 2, 2026, and March 31, 2027. All operations remain subject to government approval.

zh.title: FAA啟用阿什維爾機場新管制塔臺 投入資金升級設施
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空管理局宣布啟用阿什維爾區域機場全新121英呎高的航空管制塔臺，取代1961年建造的舊設施。該計畫由《基礎設施投資與就業法案》資助3,170萬美元興建，並另撥款1,000萬美元擴建航廈，以因應當地顯著成長的航空交通需求。
body: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）於2026年8月7日宣布，位在北卡羅來納州的阿什維爾區域機場（Asheville Regional Airport, AVL）全新121英呎高的航空管制塔臺正式啟用。這座新設施取代了建造於1961年的舊有塔臺，旨在為航空管制員提供現代化的工作環境與技術支援，以應對北卡羅來納州西部日益增長的航空交通需求。
根據FAA公布的資料，過去十年間，阿什維爾區域機場的航空公司營運起降量成長超過百分之三百，使其成為北卡羅來納州第三繁忙的機場。FAA局長 Bryan Bedford 表示，管制員在2024年海倫颶風災後復原期間曾處理大幅增加的航空交通，新設施將有助於繼續提供安全且高效的航空管制服務。
這座新管制塔臺的興建資金由FAA透過《基礎設施投資與就業法案》（IIJA）提供，總計投入3,170萬美元。此外，FAA亦透過該法案撥款1,000萬美元用於擴建與現代化該機場的航廈設施，預計將登機門數量從原本的5個增加至12個。
在全新航空管制系統計畫下，阿什維爾管制塔臺預計於2028年底前完成多項關鍵設備升級，包括新型雷達系統、取代1990年代類比系統的現代語音交換機，以及能在各種天候條件下即時追蹤地面飛機與車輛的地面意識倡議（SAI）技術。同時，FAA近期也在阿什維爾安裝了塔臺模擬系統（TSS），以加速管制員的訓練流程。

en.title: FAA Opens New Air Traffic Control Tower at Asheville Regional Airport
en.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration announced the opening of a new 121-foot air traffic control tower at Asheville Regional Airport in North Carolina, replacing a facility built in 1961. Constructed with $31.7 million in funding from the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, the new tower supports significant air traffic growth at North Carolina's third-busiest airport. The FAA is also providing $10 million to expand the terminal gate capacity and plans additional technology upgrades through 2028.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced on August 7, 2026, the opening of a new 121-foot air traffic control tower at Asheville Regional Airport (AVL) in North Carolina. The newly constructed facility replaces an older control tower that was originally built in 1961, providing air traffic controllers with updated workspace and modern technology to handle increasing flight volumes across western North Carolina.

Over the past decade, air carrier operations at Asheville Regional Airport have expanded by more than 300 percent, establishing AVL as the third-busiest airport in North Carolina. According to FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford, controllers previously managed a sharp increase in traffic during recovery efforts following Hurricane Helene in 2024. The new tower is intended to support continued air traffic growth and operational efficiency in the region.

Construction of the new control tower was funded with $31.7 million provided by the FAA through the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA). In addition to the tower project, the agency awarded $10 million in IIJA funding to expand and modernize the airport's passenger terminal, which will increase total gate capacity from five gates to 12.

The FAA plans further technology upgrades at the Asheville facility by the end of 2028 under the Brand New Air Traffic Control System initiative. These planned upgrades include state-of-the-art radars, modern voice switches replacing 1990s analog systems, and the Surface Awareness Initiative (SAI) for real-time tracking of aircraft and surface vehicles. Additionally, the agency recently installed a Tower Simulation System (TSS) at Asheville to project airport-specific scenarios and accelerate controller training.

zh.title: 達美航空將於10月開辦亞特蘭大直飛沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德航線
zh.summary: 達美航空將自2026年10月23日起開辦亞特蘭大至沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的直飛航線。此為達美航空首條直飛沙烏地阿拉伯航線，亦是美籍航空公司首次營運連接美國與利雅德的直飛服務。該航線將以空中巴士 A350-900 執飛，於10月23日至30日期間每日營運，隨後調整為每週三班。
body: 達美航空宣布將於2026年10月23日起，開啟美國亞特蘭大與沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德之間的直飛航線。這項新服務代表該航空公司首度建立前往沙烏地阿拉伯的直達連繫，亦是美國國籍航空公司營運的首條美國至利雅德直飛航線。
根據航班規劃，亞特蘭大至利雅德航線自2026年10月23日至10月30日期間將提供每日一班的營運服務，隨後班次調整為每週三班。該航線將使用空中巴士 A350-900 廣體客機執飛，客艙配置包含多個等級，並將於機上提供清真餐點選項。
達美航空總裁 Peter Carter 對此表示，開辦此項新服務反映了航空公司致力於將旅客連接至快速成長區域的努力。

en.title: Delta Air Lines to Launch Nonstop Flights Between Atlanta and Riyadh in October 2026
en.summary: Delta Air Lines will launch nonstop service between Atlanta and Riyadh starting October 23, 2026. The new route marks the airline's first direct connection to Saudi Arabia and the first nonstop service between the United States and the Saudi capital operated by a US carrier. Delta will deploy its Airbus A350-900 aircraft on the route, initially operating daily flights through October 30, 2026, before transitioning to a schedule of three weekly flights.
body: Delta Air Lines will introduce nonstop flights between Atlanta and Riyadh beginning October 23, 2026. This service represents the carrier's initial direct route to Saudi Arabia and the first direct route between the United States and the Saudi capital operated by a US airline.

The scheduled flights between Atlanta and Riyadh will initially run on a daily basis from October 23 through October 30, 2026, before transitioning to a three-times-weekly schedule. Delta plans to operate the service using Airbus A350-900 aircraft featuring multiple seating classes and offering Halal meal choices.
Peter Carter, President of Delta Air Lines, noted that the new route aligns with the airline's strategy to connect passengers with rapidly expanding international destinations.

zh.title: 美國FAA與猶他州完成油電混合動力飛機貨運測試飛行
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署宣佈，Ampaire Inc.與猶他州運輸廳已沿猶他州15號州際公路走廊完成油電混合動力展示飛行，以測試未來的空中貨運服務。該趟飛行在鹽湖城國際機場與西達城區域機場之間進行，標誌著美國運輸部在FAA eVTOL整合先導計畫下，安全整合先進空中交通航空器的第二個重要步驟。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）宣佈，Ampaire Inc.與猶他州運輸廳（UDOT）合作，在猶他州15號州際公路走廊完成了一項油電混合動力展示飛行，旨在測試未來的空中貨運服務。該次飛行航線連接鹽湖城國際機場與西達城區域機場。
此次飛行是美國運輸部在FAA eVTOL整合先導計畫（eIPP）推動下的第二個重要步驟，目標是將先進空中交通（AAM）航空器安全地整合至國家空域系統中。該先導計畫源自川普總統頒布的「釋放無人機主導地位」行政命令，旨在為下一代航空器打造全美最大的真實環境測試平台之一。
FAA副署長克里斯·羅謝洛（Chris Rocheleau）表示，FAA很高興能在eIPP計畫下支持猶他州運輸廳與Ampaire Inc.。他強調，這項展示飛行將提供寶貴的營運經驗，並協助主管機關了解如何將先進空中交通安全地整合至國家空域系統。
猶他州運輸廳廳長卡洛斯·布拉塞拉斯（Carlos Braceras）指出，運輸廳的責任是為猶他州的交通系統做好未來準備。他表示，透過「uFLY」倡議，猶他州正凝聚產業、政府與研究夥伴的力量收集資料，以便FAA能安全地評估新興航空技術，提升區域連結性並改善社群移動能力。
根據美國運輸部的規劃，當局已於2026年3月選出橫跨26個州的8個專案參與eIPP計畫，猶他州運輸廳為其中之一。FAA將利用從這些展示飛行中獲得的經驗來識別缺口並改善操作程序，猶他州運輸廳及其他參試單位亦計劃在今年剩餘時間內進行更多的測試飛行。

en.title: FAA and Utah DOT Conduct Hybrid-Electric Demonstration Flight for Future Cargo
en.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration announced that Ampaire Inc. and the Utah Department of Transportation conducted a hybrid-electric demonstration flight along Utah’s I-15 corridor to test future cargo service. The flight took place between Salt Lake City International Airport and Cedar City Regional Airport. This flight marks the second major step in the U.S. Department of Transportation’s efforts to safely integrate Advanced Air Mobility aircraft into the National Airspace System under the FAA eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP). The FAA plans to use data from the demonstration to evaluate emerging aviation technologies and improve airspace procedures.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced that Ampaire Inc. and the Utah Department of Transportation (UDOT) have conducted a hybrid-electric demonstration flight along Utah’s I-15 corridor to test future cargo service. The demonstration flight took place between Salt Lake City International Airport and Cedar City Regional Airport.

The flight represents the second major step in the U.S. Department of Transportation’s efforts to safely integrate Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) aircraft into the National Airspace System under the FAA eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP). The eIPP initiative was outlined in President Trump’s Unleashing Drone Dominance Executive Order to establish large-scale real-world testing environments for next-generation aircraft.

FAA Deputy Administrator Chris Rocheleau stated that the agency is excited to support the Utah Department of Transportation and Ampaire Inc. under the eIPP program. Rocheleau noted that the demonstration will provide valuable operational experience and help authorities understand how to safely integrate Advanced Air Mobility into the National Airspace System.

UDOT Commissioner Carlos Braceras highlighted that the demonstration shows the future of Utah's transportation system is taking flight. Braceras explained that through the uFLY initiative, Utah is bringing together industry, government, and research partners to collect data so the FAA can safely evaluate emerging aviation technologies that could expand economic opportunity and improve mobility.

In March 2026, the Department of Transportation selected eight projects across 26 states to participate in the eIPP, with the Utah Department of Transportation being one of the designated participants. The FAA will use lessons learned from these flight demonstrations to identify gaps, refine procedures, and support safe airspace integration, while UDOT and other participants plan additional test flights throughout the remainder of the year.
